Message:
Perhaps...
God has decided
to present yet
another trial before me.

On the day we promised
to make our new vow,
Florence was summoned
to eliminate a horde
of cursed creatures,
while I was left to
wait at the mansion.

At times like this,
Florence never chooses me
to accompany her.

Instead, she always asks
Alexandra or Luke...

That seed that took root
in me back then
still remains in my heart.
The covetous seed
called “jealousy.”

I’m not feeling this way
because I don’t trust Florence.

Just, there are times when
she feels so distant.

I mean, Florence places
her trust in me,
but she doesn’t ever
turn to me.

Because...unlike Luke
and the others,
I’m not strong.

But...if I were
strong enough to protect you...
would you finally...?

Suddenly, I heard voices
coming from down the hallway.
I listened quietly, only to hear...
